slug: 2024-07-02 Ghana develops its National Data Strategy with Smart Africa and Team Europe

facts.fact: On 2 July 2024 the Government of Ghana, the EU and Smart Africa completed a two-day national validation workshop on the draft National Data Strategy, reviewing the draft and its implementation roadmap; the source describes it as a draft and reports no approval or launch.

systems.owner: Government of Ghana (Ministry of Communications and Digitalisation), with Smart Africa and the EU
